title: The First Nomenclature Depth

features.name: registry-beginning
features.desc-on-touch: The first filing. A record that pre-dates its own name. You read it and remember something you never knew.

features.name: first-utterance
features.desc-on-touch: The sound before naming. A syllable the archive keeps in its throat, afraid to release it.

features.name: return-path
features.desc-on-touch: The route that leads backward through all the names to find where naming began. It loops.

features.name: unspoken-source
features.desc-on-touch: Before the first name, there was no silence — there was only the place where silence hadn't yet learned to listen.

inscription: you return seeking the name that named the naming
